facts.business: Wheels India Limited manufactures wheels for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and agricultural tractors, and also produces bus air suspension systems.
key_risks: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia affecting oil prices and supply chains
El Nino impact on monsoon and agricultural demand
Higher commodity prices in metals and fuel pushing industrial inflation
US tariffs and global trade uncertainties
Investment risk, interest rate risk, longevity risk, and salary escalation risk from defined benefit plans
